

# ctfmon.exe is all Rust (ctfmon-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/ctfmon-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# ctfmon.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/ctfmon-rust/src/ctfmon/ctfmon_cpp_h.rs)
# CLoaderWnd.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/ctfmon-rust/src/ctfmon/CLoaderWnd_cpp_h.rs)
# CRegWatcher.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/ctfmon-rust/src/ctfmon/CRegWatcher_cpp_h.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(ctfmon_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.cpp)
target_link_libraries(ctfmon_shims PRIVATE uuid cicero libmsctf libmsutb libadvapi32 libshell32 libuser32 libmsvcrt libkernel32)
target_compile_definitions(ctfmon_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_dependencies(ctfmon_shims msctf msutb)
add_cargo_module(ctfmon ctfmon-cargo ctfmon.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE ctfmon-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    DELAY_IMPORTS
    EXTRA_DEPENDS ctfmon_shims psdk reactos_idls uuid_sources)
